What we teach

Three subjects,taught chapter by chapter.

Ph

Physics

Motion, forces, waves and fields, explained with diagrams until the formula makes sense.

Ch

Chemistry

Atomic structure, bonding and reactions, with the reasoning behind each equation you balance.

Ma

Maths

Calculus and algebra worked step by step, until you can solve the problems on your own.

Inside the SSV app

What's inthe SSV app.

9:41
01

Courses follow the syllabus.

Courses are listed for your standard and subject. Each chapter has its theory videos, concept boosters and solved past papers, so you can see what comes next.

  • Filter by Physics, Chemistry or Maths
  • Theory, concept boosters, NEET, GUJCET and GSEB papers
9:41
02

Lessons from your own teachers.

The videos are recorded by the teachers you meet in class. You can pause on a hard part and watch it again as often as you need.

  • Continue where you stopped from the home screen
  • Chapter PDFs sit next to the videos
9:41
03

Notes and PDFs open in the app.

Formula sheets, study notes and question sets open inside the app, and you can save any PDF to your phone for revision before a test.

  • Notes grouped by subject and chapter
  • Downloads stay on your device
9:41
04

Your progress on one screen.

The progress screen shows the lessons you have finished, the minutes you studied this week and how far you are in each subject.

  • Weekly study minutes
  • Progress ring for every subject
9:41
05

Ask a doubt at any hour.

The study assistant explains Physics, Chemistry and Maths questions step by step. Its answers can be wrong, so check important points with your teacher.

  • Step-by-step explanations
  • Suggested questions to get you started

Access

Two waysto get access.

Unlock everything with your class code.

Students of Shree Siddhivinayak Classes get a class code from the SSV office. Enter it once, and every paid course and note for your standard opens up.

  • One code covers every subject
  • You see the courses for your standard, 11 or 12
  • Ask at the office if you don't have one

For SSV teachers

Run the whole classfrom one dashboard.

The same app has an admin console for the SSV team, so courses, notes, class codes and students are managed from a phone.

  • Add courses, chapters and video lessons
  • Upload notes and PDFs, free or paid
  • Create class codes by standard and end date
  • See students, purchases and course reviews
  • Set the support contacts students see in the app
